dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High visibility; a single thick, high-contrast white horizontal band is visible across the mid-wing section.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence with sharp, bright white linear boundaries along the edges of the dark folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Trapezoidal patch of yellowish-olive coloration on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Linear and distinct transition separating the black crown from the olive nape and dark gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white outer rectrices creating a high-contrast longitudinal stripe along the length of the tail.
